arguments.analyst: Historical data show single/double substitutions with high measured brightness (O3 Y39N 3.868; O1 T62A:E111V:I161L 4.029), while bulky hydrophobic/charged clusters collapse fluorescence (O4 1.300, O5 1.301). Small polar/neutral single edits and conservative I161L look favorable.
arguments.hypothesis: Conservative single substitutions (e.g., I161L, N144Y, N146K) preserve or improve brightness, whereas multi-site hydrophobic/charged clusters degrade it; testing isolated near-neutral edits should score near the top of the menu.

decision.analyst: Historical data show single/double substitutions with high measured brightness (O3 Y39N 3.868; O1 T62A:E111V:I161L 4.029), while bulky hydrophobic/charged clusters collapse fluorescence (O4 1.300, O5 1.301). Small polar/neutral single edits and conservative I161L look favorable.
decision.hypothesis: Conservative single substitutions (e.g., I161L, N144Y, N146K) preserve or improve brightness, whereas multi-site hydrophobic/charged clusters degrade it; testing isolated near-neutral edits should score near the top of the menu.
decision.critic: Estimates are fitted, not measured; single-edit gains may not stack, and C36/C03/C27 share near-identical estimates, limiting discrimination.
decision.selection_rationale: Top predicted brightness (C36 3.673, C03/C27 3.672, C33 3.668, C22 3.568), all low-uncertainty conservative edits, consistent with O3; C10 dropped for low estimate.
